description: Composition-controlled Smith-Waterman Z scores for mtl3 against candidate relatives
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
R=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(acc="Q8TFG4", lab="SPBPB18E9.04c (Q8TFG4)\nS. pombe Ser-rich",              obs=420.0, null_mean=411.25, null_sd=14.32, Z=0.61),
 dict(acc="O13695", lab="mtl2 (O13695)\nS. pombe Mid2-like sensor",               obs=376.0, null_mean=326.38, null_sd=23.42, Z=2.12),
 dict(acc="Q8TFG9", lab="pfl2 (Q8TFG9)\nS. pombe GPI flocculin-like",             obs=622.0, null_mean=536.13, null_sd=13.32, Z=6.44),
 dict(acc="P53214", lab="ScMtl1 (P53214)\nS. cerevisiae CWI sensor",              obs=495.0, null_mean=356.63, null_sd=16.43, Z=8.42),
 dict(acc="O13854", lab="adg2 (O13854)\nS. pombe Ser/Thr-rich",                   obs=500.0, null_mean=380.63, null_sd=13.22, Z=9.03),
 dict(acc="B6JVK2", lab="B6JVK2\nS. japonicus Ser-rich GPI-like",                 obs=574.0, null_mean=413.50, null_sd=14.69, Z=10.93),
]).sort_values("Z")
cols=["#c62828" if "mtl2" in l else "#78909c" for l in R.lab]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.2,4.8))
ax.barh(range(len(R)), R.Z, color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(R))); ax.set_yticklabels(R.lab, fontsize=8)
for i,(z,o,m,s) in enumerate(zip(R.Z,R.obs,R.null_mean,R.null_sd)):
    ax.text(z+0.2, i, f"SW {o:.0f} vs null {m:.0f}±{s:.0f}", va="center", fontsize=7.5, color="#333333")
ax.set_xlim(0,15)
ax.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman Z vs composition-preserving shuffled null (BLOSUM62, gap 11/1, 8 shuffles)")
ax.set_title("Shuffle Z is inflated by Ser/Thr composition for every target tested, so none of these is\n"
             "evidence of homology. The informative result: mtl3 matches mtl2 worst of all.", fontsize=10)
ax.annotate("mtl2, the proposed paralog,\nis the weakest match", xy=(2.12,1), xytext=(5.2,1.25),
            fontsize=8, color="#c62828", arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#c62828", lw=1))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(R.to_string(index=False))
